module sipo_8bit(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input sin,
    output reg [7:0] pout
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        pout <= 8'h00;
    end else begin
        pout <= {1'b0, pout[7:1]};
    end
end

endmodule

module siso_8bit(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input sin,
    output reg sout
);

    reg [7:0] data_reg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            data_reg <= 8'b00000000;
            sout <= 1'b0;
        end
        else begin
            data_reg <= {data_reg[6:0], sin}; // Shift right
            sout <= data_reg[0];               // Output the LSB
        end
    end

endmodule
